title: Sky settings (Super+I)
brief: Our own settings for the sky shell, replacing KDE System Settings: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, displays, sound, appearance and system, opened with Super+I

artboards.title: Sidebar window
artboards.tradeoff: Familiar and scales to many pages; feels like a separate app, least tied to the shell

artboards.title: Island sheet
artboards.tradeoff: Feels native to sky and fast for toggles; less room for deep pages like display arrangement

artboards.title: Search first + card grid
artboards.tradeoff: Fastest to find any setting and shows live state at a glance; more custom work and a full-screen takeover
